title: Reversible Hydration of CH3NH3PbI3 in Films, Single Crystals, and Solar Cells
finding: MAPbI3 reversibly forms mono- then dihydrate on humidity exposure; prolonged water drives irreversible decomposition to PbI2.

title: Investigation of CH3NH3PbI3 Degradation Rates and Mechanisms in Controlled Humidity Environments Using in Situ Techniques
finding: Direct real-time imaging of MAPbI3 hydrate formation and PbI2 conversion, resolving humidity-dependent degradation rates and pathways.

title: Transformation of the Excited State and Photovoltaic Efficiency of CH3NH3PbI3 Perovskite upon Controlled Exposure to Humidified Air
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
finding: Moderate humidified air can transiently boost then degrade MAPbI3 performance; water intercalation is initially reversible before hydrate/PbI2 formation.

title: Scaling behavior of moisture-induced grain degradation in polycrystalline hybrid perovskite thin films
finding: Moisture-induced degradation nucleates at grain boundaries and scales with grain-boundary density, identifying microstructure as a moisture-stability lever.

title: The Role of Oxygen in the Degradation of Methylammonium Lead Trihalide Perovskite Photoactive Layers
finding: Molecular O2 plus light generates superoxide that deprotonates MA+ and decomposes MAPbI3; establishes photo-oxidation as a distinct O2-driven channel.

title: Fast oxygen diffusion and iodide defects mediate oxygen-induced degradation of perovskite solar cells
finding: Iodide vacancies mediate fast O2 diffusion and superoxide formation; defect density controls photo-oxidation rate, linking defects to environmental attack.

title: Light and oxygen induced degradation limits the operational stability of methylammonium lead triiodide perovskite solar cells
finding: Combined light + O2 (not moisture alone) limits operational MAPbI3 device stability; superoxide-driven decomposition dominates in air under illumination.

title: Water-Accelerated Photooxidation of CH3NH3PbI3 Perovskite
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
finding: Trace water dramatically accelerates photo-oxidation of MAPbI3, revealing a light+O2+H2O synergy beyond either agent alone.

title: Intrinsic Thermal Instability of Methylammonium Lead Trihalide Perovskite
finding: MAPbI3 is intrinsically thermally unstable, decomposing at ~85 C even under inert atmosphere, independent of moisture/oxygen.

title: Photodecomposition and thermal decomposition in methylammonium halide lead perovskites and inferred design principles to increase photovoltaic device stability
finding: Distinguishes thermal from photochemical decomposition of MA perovskites; identifies gaseous products (CH3NH2, HI vs. NH3, CH3I) diagnostic of each route.

title: Thermal degradation of formamidinium based lead halide perovskites into sym -triazine and hydrogen cyanide observed by coupled thermogravimetry-mass spectrometry analysis
finding: FA-based perovskites thermally decompose via sym-triazine and other volatile products, showing FA is not immune to cation-loss pathways.

title: Formamidinium and Cesium Hybridization for Photo‐ and Moisture‐Stable Perovskite Solar Cell
finding: FA/Cs cation mixing yields perovskites with improved photo- and moisture-stability versus MA-based analogues, a compositional route to durability.

title: Improved air stability of perovskite solar cells via solution-processed metal oxide transport layers
finding: Metal-oxide charge-transport layers markedly improve air stability of perovskite cells, implicating interfaces/contacts in environmental degradation.

title: Overcoming ultraviolet light instability of sensitized TiO2 with meso-superstructured organometal tri-halide perovskite solar cells
finding: UV illumination of TiO2 electron-transport layers triggers photocatalytic degradation; replacing/insulating TiO2 mitigates UV instability.

title: Reversible photo-induced trap formation in mixed-halide hybrid perovskites for photovoltaics
finding: Illuminated mixed I/Br perovskites reversibly segregate into I-rich (low-gap) and Br-rich domains (the 'Hoke effect'), pinning photovoltage below the alloy gap.

title: Origin of Reversible Photoinduced Phase Separation in Hybrid Perovskites
finding: Polaron-strain model for reversible photoinduced phase separation: carrier-lattice coupling drives halide demixing, explaining reversibility.

title: Rationalizing the light-induced phase separation of mixed halide organic–inorganic perovskites
finding: Photoinduced halide segregation is governed by carrier density/thermodynamics; illumination intensity and composition set the segregation threshold.

title: The role of halide oxidation in perovskite halide phase separation
finding: Halide (iodide) oxidation to I2/I3- is a chemical driver of light-induced phase separation, coupling redox chemistry to segregation.

title: Triple-halide wide–band gap perovskites with suppressed phase segregation for efficient tandems
finding: Adding Cl to wide-gap I/Br perovskites suppresses photoinduced segregation, enabling stable ~1.67 eV tandem top cells.

title: Consensus statement for stability assessment and reporting for perovskite photovoltaics based on ISOS procedures
finding: ISOS consensus protocols standardize how moisture, thermal, light and operational stress tests are run and reported for perovskite devices.
